decisions_log.decision: calculateReadingTime always returns a string, never null — even for 0 or 10 words.
decisions_log.rationale: AC2 and AC3 both require '1 min read' to be displayed for 10 and 0 words respectively, overriding the 'should: only display if > 10 words' clause. The pre-written tests confirm this behaviour.

decisions_log.decision: Used text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 for the reading time span.
decisions_log.rationale:
These zinc utility classes are already used by the date element and the description

in the same component, making them the natural choice for 'small and muted' styling consistent with the codebase palette.

decisions_log.decision: Reading time is rendered inside the <h2> as an inline <span>, not as a sibling element.
decisions_log.rationale: Placing it inside the h2 keeps title and reading time on the same flex baseline without adding extra layout elements, matching the sketch's 'same line as the entry title' requirement.

files_changed.summary: Implements calculateReadingTime(description): splits on /\s+/, divides by 200, Math.ceil, minimum 1 — always returns a formatted string like '1 min read'.
Imports calculateReadingTime and renders the result next to the entry title inside a <span> with '•' separator and text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 styling.
Unit tests for calculateReadingTime covering empty string, whitespace-only, 10-word, 11-word, 200-word, 201-word, and 450-word cases.

Added a 'ChangelogEntry — reading time' describe block with component-level tests verifying '3 min read' for 450 words, '1 min read' for 10 and 0 words, bullet separator, and text-sm/zinc class styling.
